guitar.notes: Johnny Stevens is vocalist/guitarist; no singular documented signature instrument.

tone.target: gated fuzz-rock riff with wah bite and roomy drive
tone.profile: gated fuzz-rock riff with wah bite and roomy drive
tone.summary: Fuzz -> Wah -> Boost/OD -> Amp (UK 45) -> Cab (UK Vintage 4x12) -> EQ -> Room/Delay. This setup provides the necessary nasal fuzz bite and classic rock punch.
corrections: make fuzz primary, not side flavor

rig.name: Highly Suspect - My Name Is Human - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Slightly boost the signal into the fuzz/wah chain for maximum bite.
blocks.gap: The Boost is used here to tighten up the fuzzy attack, compensating for potential loss of definition in heavy fuzz tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core nasal fuzz tone required for the riffing.
Implement the signature wah sweeps and bite.
Provide the classic British rock punch and mid-range focus.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is chosen for its aggressive, focused midrange that cuts through fuzz without sounding overly scooped.

blocks.purpose: Ground the tone with a classic British cabinet sound.
Enhance the low-mids and overall punch for 'roomy low-mid push'.
blocks.gap: Used to manually sculpt the frequency response, ensuring the fuzz doesn't lose definition in the lower mids.

blocks.purpose: Add the required 'roomy' feel without washing out the tight riffing.
Optional subtle echo for added depth during breaks.
blocks.gap: Kept inactive by default to maintain the tight, aggressive focus of the riffing, but available for fills.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive, open-sounding British cab.

proposals.reason: Enhance the raw, aggressive punch needed for fuzz rock.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and bite in the low end.
